the trade-off is NOT monotone. Regret falls from T0 0.006348 to a minimum at T2 0.005301, then rises to T4 0.012648 and T5 0.013937. Over T0..T2 suppressing migration REDUCES residual regret, so lower cost and lower regret coincide.
T0 has the highest migration cost (9.376 GB/min) and higher residual regret (0.006348) than T2 (0.005301); the extra migrations do not buy placement quality
T5 (migration disabled) has the worst residual regret 0.013937 of all candidates, confirming static placement is not sufficient; T4 already trends that way (0.012648)
positive delta_r is far more frequent in bursty (52.8% of cycles) than steady (7.3%), so tau gates a very different number of decisions per regime
